annotation_fields_proposed.act_commitment: asserted | negated | conditional | questioned | quoted | unknown, with scope evidence; distinguish speech-act commitment from embedded predicate polarity.
annotation_fields_proposed.act_completion: complete | unfinished | ambiguous; missing annotation masked separately, not labelled unknown.
annotation_fields_proposed.completion_evidence: Exact spans and any open qualification/correction scope; no imagined completion from intended script.
annotation_fields_proposed.essential_argument_resolution: resolved | unresolved | not_applicable plus role/reference evidence; e.g. whose death, who self-identifies, or which question is answered.
annotation_fields_proposed.mask: Independent Boolean observation mask for each proposed field.

act_completion_contract_vnext.definition: Complete means the relevant act/proposition has been sufficiently expressed, without an unresolved continuation that could alter it. Essential person/target/reference resolution is a separate axis and separate admission dependency: a complete he died can still have an unresolved referent. Act completion implies neither full payment terms, policy eligibility, verified identity, consent permission nor transport integrity.

act_completion_contract_vnext.kernel_precedence: Construct the eligible semantic-act set only after source binding, act completeness, commitment/reference and relevant dependency checks. Apply policy precedence to that set. Keep known-but-unfinished acts as scoped clarification candidates; they cannot increment refusal/stop counters, close deceased, transfer or enter support solely from an intent label. Complete independent acts are retained despite unrelated partial clauses.
act_completion_contract_vnext.narrow_trial_impact: Binary primary-payment research remains possible without training all rare act heads, since it has no routing/permission authority. Any later consumer using completed-primary precedence needs actual labelled/qualified act-completion evidence for its claimed scope.
act_completion_contract_vnext.problem: An intent may be identifiable before its speech act is complete. Conversely, a completed hardship/stop/security/recipient act may coexist with an unfinished payment component or unrelated admin clause. Neither whole-turn nor component completion substitutes for per-act completion.
act_completion_contract_vnext.schema_and_mask: Current frozen semantic_proposal.v1 has no explicit act_completion or essential-person-role field. Keep wire unchanged. Proposed annotation/diagnostic extension needs a new label-pack schema/version owned by the data worker; future runtime adoption needs coordinated producer+consumer+schema versioning. Until then these heads are not_implemented/unannotated; primary score alone cannot satisfy act-completion dependencies.

adoption: Annotation-only contracts; no frozen wire/producer/consumer or label-pack mutation

date_completion_subset_experiment.candidate_detection: Measure exact-span/covered-span recall before classifier accuracy. Extend candidate evidence to include relevant open complements/punctuation and right context without absorbing a later sibling. Report missed gold spans, false candidate spans and ambiguity. Do not rely on oracle-span scores as end-to-end competence.
date_completion_subset_experiment.collection_target: A versioned exploratory extension aiming24conservatively grouped TRAIN roots and8separate development roots,2-3context/wording variants per root. This is a collection target, not an achieved count: merge reused templates/carriers and report fewer groups if appropriate. Seek at least20independently reviewed complete and20unfinished class groups before claiming the engineering data screen for this binary subset; ambiguous cases are separately masked/adjudicated.

construction_axes.scope: Only independently judged open date complement is unfinished; do not label arbitrary truncations from script intent.
Date may remain complete while time is unfinished; whole-turn partial is not date-negative.
Complete vague period stays linguistically complete with unresolved exact day; truly open comparison is unfinished/ambiguous after review.
Expression can be complete in all; resolution differs. Do not generate completeness labels by context availability alone.
Complete date spans with different polarity/commitment; not automatic unfinished negatives.
First two require per-clause/component scope. Bare trailing ellipsis may be hesitation or continuation: adjudicate/mask ambiguity, do not force unfinished from punctuation.
surfaces: the message said on the...; I choose Monday

construction_axes.scope: Complete expression; deterministic invalid/conflicting normalization, not unfinished or vague fallback.
Explicit repair direction changes effective current date; every component span and correction relation labelled, no last serialized row shortcut.

date_completion_subset_experiment.current_gap: Final TRAIN complete date49rows/22groups, unfinished1row/1group, ambiguous12/12. Reviewed gold still0 at final-fit snapshot. Reweighting or GPU cannot manufacture missing negative constructions or repair label-axis disagreement.
experiment_ladder: Adjudicate label-axis semantics and obtain real reviewed negatives; preserve old data/model.
Measure always-complete, lexical-fragment baseline, existing CPU and clause-local CPU at the same new development groups; include per-class recall and failure roots.
Freeze candidate detector+classifier+export before separate calibration/risk; final qualification remains new and blind.
If reviewed data and CPU comparison show a plausible representation bottleneck, consider one bounded teacher/comparator on the SAME narrow labels; no need to train all rare heads.
date_completion_subset_experiment.features_now: Small CPU candidate classifier with span tokens, bounded left AND right local context, clause-boundary indicators, current question role and explicit source-grounded reference relations. Candidate generation is an independent versioned component; no hardcoded day/date/amount fixtures. Whole-turn bag words may remain a comparator, not the only scope signal.
date_completion_subset_experiment.gpu_interpretation: Zero currently accepted runtime frames does not by itself prohibit offline GPU research. Launch still needs actual reviewed-label quality, justified expected representation benefit, verified bounded training adapter/SDK/wall-stop and parent reservation. Phone raw ingress/consent/deployment qualification remains a separate gate; GPU improvement does not close it.
date_completion_subset_experiment.loss: Masked binary CE for adjudicated complete vs unfinished; genuinely ambiguous or axis-disputed items are not forced negatives. Compute average loss within lineage group then average groups, separately per head. Start equal head weights; optionally predeclared inverse-sqrt TRAIN-group class weights capped5 versus unweighted baseline. Never multiply rare variants into independent weight.
date_completion_subset_experiment.masks: Train only the narrow supported completion subset; act completion, target identity, offer/consent and unreviewed rare intent heads stay masked. Date-complete logits cannot authorize normalization or clear a kernel pending obligation by themselves.
date_completion_subset_experiment.optional_pair_loss: Only on adjudicated complete/unfinished pairs for the SAME semantic component and genuinely comparable context, add lambda*max(0,margin-z_complete+z_unfinished), e.g. predeclared lambda=.1,margin=1. No such constraint on complete-vague vs complete-exact, negated vsasserted, or date-complete/time-unfinished. Group the pair and retain a no-pair-loss control.
date_completion_subset_experiment.target: Scoped date-expression completion conditioned on actual candidate span and clause context. Separate it from act completion and deterministic unique-date normalization.

three_axes.act: Did the customer complete/assert the relevant act?
three_axes.expression: Is the date expression linguistically complete, unfinished, or genuinely ambiguous?
three_axes.normalization: Does the complete expression yield one consistent policy-valid date, a vague range, unresolved reference, invalid/conflicting expression or exact_unparsed form?
